title: 6.1 Buildings and Services
unit_outcome: Name places in town and ways to travel, say where places are, give simple directions, say what you can and cannot do, ask for help, and read simple bus and train times.
goal: Recognize and name a station, a bank, a pharmacy and a library, and say which place a family member is at.
grammar_function: It is a bank. The mother is at the pharmacy. The children are in the library.
prerequisite: 2.1 places; 1.4-1.6 family words; 4.1 and 4.3 in; 4.10 at.
speaking_outcome: Name a place in town and say who is there.
